result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but there are a few minor layout and content issues, including a cut-off restaurant name and a potentially empty profile icon area.

issues.description: The name of the third restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off, displaying 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the text container allows for the full restaurant name to be displayed or implement an ellipsis (...) to indicate truncated text.

issues.description: The circular icon in the top right corner appears to be empty or contains only a small red dot, which might be confusing to users.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the purpose of this icon, perhaps by adding a recognizable symbol (like a notification bell or user avatar) or removing it if it's not functional.

issues.description: The 'See all' links in the 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections are right-aligned, which might not be immediately obvious to all users.
issues.suggestion: Consider making the 'See all' link more prominent or placing it in a more conventional location, such as next to the section title.
